roundingNote: Published demand categories are rounded to one decimal place. Their displayed sum is 0.1 Moz above the published total; the published market balance is preserved separately for source comparison.

notes: The default engine uses the latest completed full-year physical-market reference rather than the 2026 forecast.
A flow deficit is not the same as an immediate shortage; above-ground inventories and investor holdings can absorb or release metal.
The browser reads this bundled same-origin file only and does not call Silver Institute, Metals Focus or USGS endpoints.
Physical silver data are reviewed annually rather than updated by a blind automated PDF scrape.
